citation: Yan B, Boitano M, Clark TA, Ettwiller L (2018) Nature Communications 9:3676. SMRT-Cappable-seq reveals complex operon variants in bacteria.
datasetVersion: Supplementary Data 1 (41467_2018_5997_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx) and Supplementary Data 2 (41467_2018_5997_MOESM5_ESM.xlsx), article published 2018-09-10, retrieved 2026-09-16; gene symbols and current locus tags from the NCBI RefSeq NC_000913.3 GenBank file (LOCUS date 09-DEC-2025)

notes: Records: 2567 of 2605 distinct start sites. Derived from the unit tables, not a full start-site catalogue: each record is a distinct 5' start of a Supplementary Data 1 TSS-TTS pair or a Supplementary Data 2 operon row. The paper reports 2,186 (M9) and 1,902 (Rich) start sites but does not publish that full list. Removed as likely rRNA processing sites: 38 starts that lie inside an rRNA gene more than 10 nt past its 5' end (rrlA 4, rrlC 6, rrlD 5, rrlE 4, rrlG 7, rrlH 5, rrsA 1, rrsB 1, rrsC 1, rrsD 2, rrsG 1, rrsH 1). Supplementary Data 2 pools M9 and Rich without condition labels, so no conditions are recorded. Not kept in records.json (reproducible from the build script): the gene lists, operon-variant counts, per-condition read counts and table of origin; the record name keeps the first gene. 13 retired b-numbers were replaced by the current locus tag that lists them as /gene_synonym in the GenBank file (b0255->b4587, b0257->b4587, b1016->b4490, b1017->b4490, b1405->b4492, b1416->b4493, b1417->b4493, b1509->b4696, b2090->b4498, b2999->b4658, b3000->b4658, b3767->b4488, b3768->b4488); a list that then named the same locus twice keeps it once. 8 published b-numbers have no current locus tag or synonym and are kept as published, with the b-number as the gene symbol (b0079, b0100, b0165, b0725, b1052, b1903, b3036, b4250). Never read: Supplementary Data 2 columns 4-5 (RegulonDB comparison) and Supplementary Data 1 columns 10-12 (EcoCyc terminator comparison); Supplementary Data 3 (re-published RegulonDB operons) is never downloaded.
